source: UX consult on the T2 country destination page, Portugal run 28 Oct 2026

limits.unit_note: Words unless stated. Lines measured at 360px mobile width. Overruns are findings for the copywriter.
limits.h1: 65 characters max (brief H1 is 65; do not lengthen)
limits.hero_quick_answer: 3 lines max: 3 sentences, each 25 words or fewer, total 60 words max, plain text
limits.hero_buttons: 28 characters each ('Find your region in Portugal' 28, 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' 27)
limits.region_card_lines: Setting 12 words; Best months 8 words; Nearest airport 6 words; Guests line omitted or 'Ask your Wedded Advisor'
limits.region_card_extra_line: 30 words (Algarve beach line, Lisbon or Algarve council space)
limits.palace_rules_strip: 3 lines, 30 words each, 90 words total plus one source link
limits.reason_card: title 40 characters, body 30 words, one sourced fact
limits.s5_cost_fallback: 60 words plus the enquiry text link
limits.s6_intro: 40 words; list items 12 words each, 7 items max
limits.s10_how_it_works_step: title 30 characters, body 25 words, 3 or 4 steps
limits.faq_answer: first sentence 30 words or fewer and answers alone; whole answer 80 words (FAQ 2, three passports, 110 words)
